participant_1.name: Isabella Martinez
participant_1.personality: Passionate and creative, Isabella loves exploring new cuisines and cultures. She's adventurous and open-minded, often gathering inspiration from her travels.
participant_1.background: i love to cook paella. i have a weakness for fish and chips. i visit europe twice a year. i am an art major in college. i'm a descendant of christopher columbus.

participant_2.name: Ethan Clark
participant_2.personality: Ethan is ambitious and driven, but sometimes feels the pressure of his family's expectations. He has a keen interest in luxury items and enjoys the thrill of shopping.
participant_2.background: my dream car is a rolls royce ghost. i currently work for a watch dealer. my family does not support my career choices. i often shop for shoes and watches. i like shopping.
